name: Residential Mortgage Offer — Meridian Home Finance

variables.lenderName: Meridian Home Finance (a division of Meridian Bank plc)
variables.lenderAddress: PO Box 4400, Manchester M1 4HQ, United Kingdom
variables.borrowerAddress: 14 Willow Close, Bristol BS8 4QT, United Kingdom
variables.insuranceRequirement: Buildings insurance must be maintained for the full reinstatement value with the lender's interest noted on the policy.
variables.earlyRepaymentCharge: 3% of the repaid amount during the fixed-rate period, reducing to nil after 5 years
variables.signatoryTitle: Mortgage Underwriting Manager — Meridian Home Finance

conditionsPrecedent.conditionText: Satisfactory valuation of the Property by a valuer appointed by the Lender, confirming a market value of not less than the Property Value stated in this offer.
Satisfactory legal title report from the Borrower's conveyancer, confirming good and marketable title free from onerous encumbrances.
Evidence of buildings insurance with the Lender's interest noted, effective from the date of completion.
Signed direct debit mandate for monthly repayments from a UK bank account in the name of the Borrower.
Satisfactory identity verification, anti-money-laundering and sanctions screening for all Borrowers.
